title: Meal Plan Leftover Utilisation by Week
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealplan:item
| search leftover_use_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(leftover_use_pct) as avg_leftover_use_pct count as meal_items by _time week_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks leftover utilisation over time and breaks it out by week.
value: Leftover utilisation is a simple truth-teller for whether the plan is reducing waste or just moving it around.
implementation: Send leftover utilisation events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of leftover utilisation by week.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how leftover utilisation changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
